name: One Shot. One Kill.
summary: On the road to Auberdine, Sentinel Aynasha needs help to survive an ambush and deliver her message. Marosh the Devious and his furbolg trackers have poisoned her, leaving her unable to travel while she mixes an antidote.

sections.title: Ambush on the Forest Road
sections.body: Sentinel Aynasha was carrying important communications toward Auberdine when hostile furbolgs intercepted her on a northern Kalimdor trail. Marosh the Devious led the pack. Their venom left the scout unsteady and unable to continue on foot.

sections.title: Holding the Line
sections.body: Aynasha knows how to make natural remedies, but mixing and taking an antidote takes time. Marosh's trackers are closing in, so she needs travelers to guard her while she works. Though her strength is failing, she keeps her bow steady and fires into the brush to hold the attackers back.

sections.title: Report to Maestra's Post
sections.body: After Marosh is slain and the assault ends, the antidote restores enough strength for Aynasha to continue to Auberdine. She asks her protectors to carry word of the aggressive furbolgs threatening regional supply routes to Sentinel Onaeya at Maestra's Post, south in Ashenvale.

faq.answer: Sentinel Aynasha is a night elf scout carrying important messages between Darkshore and Ashenvale. Skilled with a bow and woodland survival, she was poisoned in an ambush while on duty.
A pack of hostile furbolgs led by Marosh the Devious attacked Sentinel Aynasha. They poisoned her in the clash, leaving her unable to move freely.
Aynasha was traveling to Auberdine with an important dispatch when Marosh and his trackers trapped her on the road.

faq.q: Why must you report to Sentinel Onaeya?
faq.answer: Aynasha needs to reach Auberdine with her message, so she asks you to go south to Maestra's Post in Ashenvale and alert Sentinel Onaeya to the furbolg hostility.

faq.q: Why are the furbolgs in the area hostile?
faq.answer: Many furbolg tribes across Darkshore and Ashenvale have fallen to demonic taint and madness since the Third War. They attack traveling Sentinels and wayside travelers without distinction.

faq.q: Does Aynasha fight during the ambush?
faq.answer: Yes. The venom leaves Aynasha barely able to stand, but she fires her bow to cover her defender while preparing the antidote.

angles.text: As a night elf, you protect a fellow Sentinel and the important communications moving between outposts in Ashenvale and northern Darkshore.
As an Alliance member, you help keep woodland paths clear of aggressive furbolgs and safe for travel between Ashenvale and Alliance strongholds to the north.
As a hunter, you can see Aynasha's resolve in the shots she continues to fire into the brush while the venom weakens her.
